title: Act: Do not report loading when no history request is made
summary: Initialise and reset historyStatus to ready when there is no round id or the sheet is closed
description: In ContributionSheet, make historyStatus 'ready' whenever the history effect does not fire a request (roundId === '' or !open), and keep 'loading' only while listMine is in flight.
acceptance_criteria: With roundId '' the status is 'ready' on first render
With roundId set the status is 'loading' until listMine settles

in_scope: ContributionSheet.tsx historyStatus initial state and early-return branch
preserve: Loading and error rendering at L153-L157

technical_constraints: Do not add a second status state; keep a single writer
definition_of_done: Loading message absent when roundId is ''

steps.action: Change the initial state so it is 'loading' only when a request will be made: derive it from open and roundId instead of the constant 'loading'.
steps.expected: First render with roundId '' has historyStatus 'ready' so no loading paragraph renders

steps.action: Replace the early return with a branch that sets status 'ready' before returning, so reopening with an empty round id or closing never leaves 'loading'.
steps.code: if (!open || roundId === '') return; -> if (!open || roundId === '') { setHistoryStatus('ready'); return; }
steps.expected: Status is 'ready' whenever no listMine request is issued; request path still sets 'loading' at L53
